Test drive will help:

  • Find out if a particular model is right for you;

We will teach you or your kid how to safely drive

During the training, the specialist will teach you:

  • How to prepare a scooter for a trip;
  • How to “start” a scooter;
  • How to behave during a trip and protect yourself and others;
  • How to fold and unfold an electric scooter;
  • How to care for your device.
